note: Sogebank's fee grid (March 2026, before the turnover tax, whose rate it doesn't state): its credit cards cost 1,485 to 23,760 gourdes a year to issue and hold the main card, by card, and bear monthly interest of 3.17% to 4.67%. The card isn't named, so the lowest fee, its basic card's, is written with the top of the interest range.

sources.title: Sogebank, Frais applicables (hors TCA), March 2026
sources.said: IV- CARTE(S) DE CREDIT. FRAIS: Frais d'émission /Cotisation annuelle Carte principale, HTG 1,485.00 @ 23,760.00, USD N/A. Intérêts mensuels, HTG 3.17% @ 4.67%, USD N/A. (Read by eye from page 2 of the image-only document, footed DCRP 27022026.)
